correctness.rationale: Greedy binary arch-factorization index counts completed shortest mixed-letter prefixes. Each arch is 0^{s+1}1 or 1^{s+1}0, subject to Dyck nonnegativity; terminal unfinished suffix must be forced 1^h. Semilength calculation yields n−index=total positive arch increments. First-step recurrences for arch-height F_h solve a quadratic and lead to exact F0=C(z(1-z)/(1-x)); substitution z=tu, x=t yields the stated composition. Independently enumerated all Dyck words n<=10 and compared exact coefficients. Dominant square-root singularity ρ(u)=(4u+1−sqrt(8u+1))/(8u²), unique near u=1, gives mean 2/3 and variance 4/27 via quasi-powers; independent rational derivative checks passed. Normality is an infinite singularity-analysis deduction, not established by finite counts.
